text: Confirming exact meaning of CC_IMPORT_017 before I update a customer: is it any owner problem, or specifically an unknown email?
Specifically: owner_email was supplied but does not match an active user in that tenant.
Blank owner_email does not trigger it?
Correct. Blank or absent assigns the importing user. Only an explicit invalid value gets CC_IMPORT_017.
That distinction matches what I saw in the Northwind dry run.
